findings.evidence: `quadrupoleS_cycle U x y z w : quadrupoleS U x y z w = quadrupoleS U z w x y` (line 171-173); instantiating at `(x, y, z, x)` gives `Q z x x y`, which is exactly `quadrupoleS_self_mid U z x y` (line 157-159). Instantiating at `(x, y, z, z)` gives `Q z z x y`, exactly `quadrupoleS_self_left U z x y` (line 143-145).
findings.fix: Move `quadrupoleS_cycle` above the coincidence limits, prove `quadrupoleS_self_left` and `quadrupoleS_self_mid` directly as now, and derive the other two: `quadrupoleS_self_right := by rw [quadrupoleS_cycle]; exact quadrupoleS_self_left U z x y` and `quadrupoleS_self_outer := by rw [quadrupoleS_cycle]; exact quadrupoleS_self_mid U z x y`.
findings.issue: `quadrupoleS_self_outer` uses a six-step `rw` chain (`trace_mul_comm, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, star_mul_self_of_mem, one_mul, trace_mul_comm`) whose two `trace_mul_comm` steps rely on which subterm matches first, yet the result is an immediate consequence of `quadrupoleS_cycle` (line 171) plus `quadrupoleS_self_mid`: `Q x y z x = Q z x x y = S z y`. The same holds for `quadrupoleS_self_right` (line 152), which is `quadrupoleS_cycle` plus `quadrupoleS_self_left`: `Q x y z z = Q z z x y = S x y`.

findings.evidence: Multipole.lean:179-182 and Operator.lean:80-83 differ only in the number of factors; `Matrix.trace_conjTranspose : trace Aᴴ = star (trace A)` (upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Trace.lean:75) plus `Complex.conj_re` is the whole content in both.
findings.fix: Add `Matrix.re_trace_conjTranspose : (Aᴴ.trace).re = A.trace.re` (or the `RCLike` form) to `Matrix/UnitaryTrace.lean`, the module this PR already extends for shared trace facts, and use it in both `dipoleS_comm` and `quadrupoleS_reverse`.
findings.issue: `quadrupoleS_reverse` repeats verbatim the idiom of `dipoleS_comm` (Operator.lean:80-83): a `have` rewriting the reversed product as `(...)ᴴ`, then `simp only [..., trace_conjTranspose, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_re]`. The reusable fact — the real part of a trace is invariant under conjugate transpose — is left inline in two places.

summary: Proofs are mostly robust simp-driven one-liners with no defeq manipulation, but two coincidence limits re-derive by hand what `quadrupoleS_cycle` already proves, one of them through a six-step positionally-sensitive `rw` chain. A smaller conjugate-transpose idiom is duplicated between `dipoleS_comm` and `quadrupoleS_reverse`.
